description: Expected output format for /app/results.json. All numeric values are floats. effective_dof is null when infinite (all-Gaussian inputs). Coverage intervals are [lower, upper] arrays.

gum.estimate: float: model evaluated at best estimates
gum.effective_dof: float or null: Welch-Satterthwaite effective DOF

mcm.estimate: float: mean of all MC model values
mcm.uncertainty: float: std dev of all MC model values
mcm.num_trials: int: total number of MC trials

validation.delta: float: numerical tolerance from MCM u(y)
validation.validated: bool: true iff d_low <= delta and d_high <= delta
